```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
```


```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5)
```
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package"
  )+
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = "sqrt",
    position = "right"
  )
```
lets try some other scales
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-15, 0, 15), 
    labels = c("-15º C", "0", "15"))
```

lets look at color
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .5) + 
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "Minimum daily temperature (C)",
    y = "Maxiumum daily temperature (C)",
    color = "Location",
    caption = "Data from the rnoaa package") + 
  scale_color_hue(h = c(100, 300))
```
